visualCharacteristics: Looping content-card carousel with dot navigation; two cards per view on desktop (three with the wide option), one per view below 1200px.
contentPattern: One row per slide: image | h3 title, body paragraph, link paragraph (link text is the arrow label, its href is the card link). Section heading and trailing CTA are default content in the section.
usage: Promo and "more to explore" card rows that scroll horizontally.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any scrolling set of linked content cards. Add the wide option for full-bleed, three-per-view layouts.
